name: Warp Finance LP collateral priced from spot reserves
summary: UniswapLPOracleFactory.getUnderlyingPrice valued a Uniswap V2 LP token from TWAP unit prices times the pair's instantaneous reserves over totalSupply. With flash-loaned swaps the attacker skewed the DAI/WETH pair, inflating the value of its DAI/WETH LP collateral in WarpControl's borrow limit, and borrowed the DAI and USDC lending vaults dry.
notes: The age runs from the owner's createNewOracles call that registered the USDC price instance (tokenToUSDC[USDC]); before it, borrowSC(USDC) reverted, and it is the latest of the oracle and market registrations the anchor needed (DAI/WETH LP listing and DAI pricing came a few minutes earlier).

WarpControl applied the price it was given; the defect is the factory's reserve-based LP pricing. The DAI/WETH LP the attacker left as collateral, later recovered by Warp, is not subtracted (rule 14). Stablecoins valued at par.
